cold_start_inclusive.interpretation: initial-alpha cold start; no AIMD opportunity is available during the registered arrival horizon

steady_state.cohort_rule: report workflows whose common workflow_arrival_ms is >=90000 and <=180000; warmup tasks are executed and retained in raw state but never mixed into the steady-state cohort statistic
steady_state.interpretation: preregistered complementary steady-state view; never replaces or deletes cold-start-inclusive evidence

healthy_accounting.prompt_seal_schedule: chunk ordinal becomes eligible at dispatch + prefill_setup_ms + token_end * prefill_ms_per_token; it never reads realized output length or realized final service time
healthy_accounting.normal_path_copy_wct_rule: source-owned HBM and DRAM copies are asynchronous and independently queued; transfer or copy-lane wait is not directly added to output WCT. Only serving-HBM capacity competition enters dispatch/queue WCT. Copy completion still controls committed recovery state.
healthy_accounting.copy_path_composition: max of independent HBM and DRAM own transfer service for reporting only; never sum
healthy_accounting.serving_priority: a primary serving reservation may evict or reject Peer-HBM backup at the physical target; a protection reservation never delays its source request dispatch
healthy_accounting.topology_bijection: even local GPU indices use same-node successor; odd local GPU indices use next-node predecessor, giving one logical source per physical Peer-HBM target
healthy_accounting.modeled_boundary: Copy bandwidths, service coefficients and contention semantics remain modeled and are not A100 measurements.

batched_s2.event_seed_derivation: sha256(experiment_id, workload_seed, window_index, decimal rate) first 64 bits
batched_s2.policy_pairing: the exact same frozen window ledger is replayed for both policies
batched_s2.zero_event_memoization: a zero-event window uses the exact healthy DES output for the matching policy/workload seed; an executable equivalence gate must show zero-event injection is byte-for-byte equal in completion values
batched_s2.estimator: arithmetic mean over all actual independent 90s window samples, including every zero-event window; never conditional WCT times analytic probability
batched_s2.effective_sample_reporting: report total windows, event-bearing windows, accepted/no-op events, unique workload seeds and per-seed window counts

pilot.purpose: bounded mechanism and estimator validation only; not paper-ready

hard_gates: copy byte and duration accounting conserves admitted per-tier bytes
HBM and DRAM transfer service uses max not sum
asynchronous copy is not directly charged to serving finish
physical target HBM occupancy equals logical controller occupancy under a bijective mapping
serving plus target backup never exceeds the frozen shared budget
all prompt seals occur after dispatch and use no realized-output oracle
a request's unsealed or future backup is never part of its own dispatch gate
physical target aggregation across source routes never exceeds 40 GiB
evicted or reclaimed replica bytes are absent from the committed recovery prefix
all batch ledgers are generated and hashed before event-bearing replay
zero-event memoization exactly matches an executed zero-event DES
event ledgers and workload universes are paired across policies
no seed or window is selected by result shape
